item.title: Bose Lifestyle Ultra Speaker
item.description: Powerful enough to drench any space in lush, clear audio and versatile enough to expand into a multiroom setup. Use solo or pair two for stereo. Use in concert with a Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar and Subwoofer for dynamic surround sound.

item.description: Mount your Bose soundbar to the wall with the Bose Soundbar Wall Bracket.

item.title: BOYA BY-M1 Pro II Lavalier Microphone
item.description: Upgrade lavalier microphone (no battery needed), clip-on mic for smartphones, camcorders, DSLR, audio recorders, PC. Omnidirectional, selectable -10dB pad, switchable smartphone/camera mode, 3.5mm headphone jack.

item.title: BOYA BY-M1DM Dual Omnidirectional Lavalier Mic
item.description: Dual omnidirectional lavalier mic for smartphones, DSLR, camcorders, audio recorders, PC. Excellent for interviews, improved sensitivity and signal-to-noise.

item.title: BOYA BY-MM1 Universal Compact Microphone
item.description: Compact on-camera shotgun microphone, compatible with smartphones, DSLRs, consumer camcorders, PCs. Rugged metal construction, no battery required.

item.title: BOYA BY-M1000 Pro Large Diaphragm Studio Microphone
item.description: Large diaphragm XLR condenser microphone for podcast, voiceover, home studio recording. Gold-sputtered diaphragm, broadcast-quality, cardioid/omnidirectional/bidirectional patterns, off-axis rejection, included shockmount & pop filter, digital switching high-pass filter and -10dB pad.

item.title: BOYA BY-PM700 USB Microphone
item.description: USB microphone compatible with Windows and Mac computers. 16Bit/48kHz resolution, stereo/cardioid/omnidirectional/bidirectional polar patterns, triple-capsule design, mute function, 1/8 headphone monitoring jack.

item.title: BOYA K9 Condenser USB Microphone
item.description: Condenser USB microphone with Hi-Fi quality sound 48kHz/24-bit, innovative one-tap noise cancellation, 3 polar patterns (supercardioid, Figure-8, omnidirectional), RGB lighting with 3 vibrant effects, real-time monitoring via 3.5mm TRS.

item.title: BOYAMIC Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz dual-channel wireless mic, up to 300m wireless transmission, separate noise cancellation control (48kHz/24bit HD), 8GB memory (up to 15 hrs recording), windproof capsule, magnet attach, rotating fur windshield, OLED display, selectable mono/stereo/safety track, 3.5mm TRS/USB-C/iOS Lightning output, charging case included.

item.title: BOYAMIC 2 AI-Powered Mini Wireless Microphone
item.description: AI-powered mini wireless microphone. True AI noise cancellation up to 40dB, 90dB SNR, 2TX-4RX connection supports up to 8 devices, 32-bit float onboard REC with 8GB storage, AGC & limiter, sleek soundwave design, up to 300m transmission.

item.title: BOYALINK Wireless Microphone System
item.description: All-in-one design wireless microphone system with dual 2.4G channels. USB-C, Lightning and 3.5mm TRS connectors, all-in-one storage design, dual-channel wireless, easy-to-use setup, comes with 3 different adapters.

item.title: BOYALINK 2 Wireless Microphone
item.description: Upgraded 3-in-1 compact wireless microphone with 3 interchangeable adapters, full compatibility with cameras/mobile/computers, 2-level noise cancellation, up to 300m line-of-sight range, MFi-certified, 48kHz 24-bit studio-quality sound, up to 30 hours battery life.

item.title: BOYALINK 3 AI-Powered Button-Sized Wireless Microphone
item.description: AI-powered button-sized wireless microphone. True AI noise cancellation up to 40dB, 85dB SNR HIFI sound, AGC/limiter/safety track, 2TX-4RX supports up to 8 devices, discreet 9g button-sized mic with dustproof grille, customizable EQ tuning, up to 300m range.

item.title: BOYA MINI 2 Wireless Microphone
item.description: Upgraded super mini wireless microphone with AI noise cancellation. 5g thumb-sized mic, upgraded AI noise cancellation up to -40dB, 48kHz/24-bit audio, 80dB SNR, 120dB max SPL, limiter & safety track, BOYA Central App for gain and EQ presets, 6 hrs battery per mic, up to 30 hrs with case.

item.title: BOYA BY-WM4 Pro-K2 Dual-Channel Wireless Microphone Kit
item.description: Dual-channel digital wireless microphone kit consisting of two body-pack transmitters and a portable receiver. Super-clear recording sound, master volume control, up to 84dB signal/noise ratio, headphone jack for real-time monitoring, up to 60m operation range, powered by two AAA batteries.

item.title: BOYA BY-WM8 Pro-K2 UHF Dual-Channel Wireless Microphone Kit
item.description: UHF dual-channel wireless microphone system with two transmitters and one receiver. Easy-to-read LCD display, 48 selectable channels, broadcast-quality sound, selectable stereo/mono mode, headphone monitoring, up to 100m operation range, ideal for interviews, broadcast, EFP, ENG.

item.title: BOYA BY-XM6-S2 Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz dual-channel wireless microphone system, 2 transmitters + 1 receiver. Ideal for two-person vlog, YouTube video, live streaming, interview, recording. Hi-Fi low-noise audio, OLED display, built-in Li-ion batteries (7h TX, 6.5h RX), up to 100m range.

item.title: BOYA BY-XM6-K2 Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz adaptive frequency hopping wireless microphone system, 2 transmitters + 1 receiver + charging case. Ideal for two-person vlog, YouTube video, live streaming, interview, recording. Double the working hours with charging case.

item.title: BOYA BY-V1 Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz wireless microphone for iOS devices (Lightning). Omnidirection built-in mic for 360-degree sound pickup, ultra compact receiver, selectable noise cancellation, up to 9 hours operation time.

item.title: BOYA BY-V10 Wireless Microphone
item.description: 2.4GHz wireless microphone for USB Type-C devices. Omnidirection built-in mic for 360-degree sound pickup, ultracompact & portable, selectable noise cancellation, automatic pairing & plug & play.

item.title: BOYA BY-V2 Wireless Microphone (Dual)

item.title: BOYA BY-V20 Wireless Microphone (Dual)

item.title: BOYA BY-K171 Microphone Boom Arm

item.title: BOYA BY-K4 Audio Adapter
item.description: 3.5mm TRS (Female) to Type-C (Male) audio adapter, specially designed for connecting 3.5mm TRS microphone with Android devices or other devices with Type-C connectors.
